clinical_intent: A 72-year-old man with a T2N0M0 prostate cancer (Gleason 7, PSA 12) is evaluating brachytherapy options. He has significant lower urinary tract symptoms (IPSS score 18) and a prostate volume of 60 cc. Analyze whether he is a suitable candidate for brachytherapy considering his LUTS, prostate volume, and cancer risk group. What modifications to the standard approach might be needed?
